weights_source: NVMe (warm cache, all 3 runs same instance)
headline_findings: Prefetch ON beats prefetch OFF on local NVMe by ~25% — defeats vLLM v0.21.0's auto-disable heuristic
Aggressive tuning (32 threads, 64MB blocks) marginally beats default (8/16MB) by 10s — 1.7% additional gain
Page cache fills in 8.66 s for 585 GB on instance NVMe — implies ~67 GB/s read throughput
Remaining weight load time (243 s) is purely cudaMemcpy/torch overhead, NOT disk-bound
Steering rule: always force --safetensors-load-strategy=prefetch on local NVMe
Steering rule: default tuning (8 threads, 16MB) captures ~95% of available win; no need to over-tune
implications_for_specs: Spec B's RunAI Streamer no-win finding now makes sense — page cache prefetch already does the parallelism RunAI Streamer would add
Weight-load bottleneck is post-page-cache (cudaMemcpy + torch loader overhead)
Without vLLM internals work, weight-load floor on local NVMe at TP=8 for 585 GB is ~243 s
ModelExpress P2P (replica-N≥2) is the only path below this floor — peer's HBM bypasses both disk and cudaMemcpy
